prompts: Four equal panels left-to-right: 1 stands beside ornate wooden trading desk thinking with one hand touching beard, other relaxed; 2 holds a parchment chart in both hands studying; 3 at same desk clicks computer mouse, other hand clenched confidently near chest; 4 same as 3 smiling confidently. Monitor shows generic rising candlesticks.

Four equal panels left-to-right: 1 seated at ornate wooden trading desk angry flushed cheeks, both hands resting on desk; 2 fists clenched in anger near chest above desk; 3 leans forward angrily clicking mouse with one hand, other fist on desk; 4 points at monitor with one hand, other rests by two stacks of gold coins on desk. Generic candle chart.

Four equal panels left-to-right: 1 seated stunned at ornate wooden trading desk, both hands on desk; 2 one hand holds forehead sadly other hand rests on desk; 3 holds an empty coin pouch open in both hands; 4 regretful calm realization, one hand open to viewer explaining, other on chest. Modern monitor and desk in all four panels.
